# Retail POS 3.0.0-RC4

Retail POS 3.0.0-RC4 focuses on smoother daily sales operations, clearer ticket editing, and more reliable product and stock management.

## Highlights

- Cash movement and sales screens now handle keypad and physical keyboard input more reliably.
- Ticket editing, ticket navigation, and payment validation have been refined for more consistent operation.
- Stock movement history and product finder workflows have been improved.
- Product import handling, quoted catalogue names, local pricing, and product editor saves are more robust.
- Application update version checks and button contrast have been corrected.

## Distribution

This release candidate is distributed as portable x86_64 packages for Linux, Windows, and Intel macOS. Windows and macOS packages include a bundled Java runtime; the Linux package uses the system Java installation. Every package includes a SHA256 checksum.

Native installers, Apple Silicon support, Linux ARM64 support, and platform signing remain planned follow-up work.
